## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-*juǎn* *yǎnyì* 演義 ("explanatory amplification") of [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Yúnqī Zhūhóng's *Shūchāo* [KR6p0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0019) by the late-Wànlì monk [古德法師](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%A4%E5%BE%B7%E6%B3%95%E5%B8%AB) Gǔdé fǎshī of Yúnqīsì, edited and finalised after his death by his disciple [慈航智願](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%88%E8%88%AA%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%98) Cíháng Zhìyuàn. The work is a sustained sub-commentary that proceeds through Zhūhóng's *Shūchāo* paragraph by paragraph, expanding compressed argumentation, supplementing canonical citation, and addressing apparent ambiguities. It is the most extensive of the supplementary works on the *Shūchāo* — the *Shìyì* [KR6p0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0020) is a glossary, the *Wènbiàn* [KR6p0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0021) is a defensive Q-and-A, but the *Yǎnyì* is a full sub-commentary in the classical Chinese mode.

**Abstract**

The *Yǎnyì* preserves the doctrinal and pedagogical structure of the late-Wànlì Yúnqīsì circle's reception of the *Shūchāo* — the immediate post-Zhūhóng generation working out the implications of his synthetic Pure Land position. The text engages closely with [傳燈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%B3%E7%87%88) Chuándēng's rival Tiāntái-school *Yuánzhōngchāo* [KR6p0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0018) and with Tiāntái critiques of Zhūhóng's *yīxíng sìmén* doctrine, defending the synthetic position with extensive doctrinal argument. The text adopts the standard format for the late-Míng sub-commentary: each main heading begins with a *biāo* 標 quoting the *Shūchāo* lemma, then a *shì* 釋 (gloss), then a *zhèng* 證 (canonical attestation), then optional *biàn* 辯 (defence against possible objections).

The dating bracket (c. 1615–1640) is by inference: Zhūhóng died in 1615, and the *Yǎnyì* presupposes both the *Shūchāo* and the *Wènbiàn* as canonical reference points. Cíháng Zhìyuàn's editorial completion plausibly falls in the 1620s or 1630s; Wànlì → Tiānqǐ → Chóngzhēn covers the relevant period.
